config.prompt: A pale woman in her early thirties with a short black bob haircut, thin silver hoop earrings, faint freckles, wearing an oversized rust-orange wool coat over a charcoal turtleneck. She stands at a weathered wooden counter in a small sunlit kitchen, slowly stirring a copper pot of soup with a wooden spoon. Late-afternoon light falls through a window to her left, dust motes in the beam. The camera pushes in slowly from a medium shot to a medium close-up; she tastes the soup and smiles slightly. Natural handheld micro-motion throughout. Audio: gentle simmering, the wooden spoon tapping the copper pot, a quiet kitchen fan hum, soft piano notes from a radio in the next room.
config.shift_source: MiniMaxH3 model class defaults (supported_models.py:968), no shift node
config.knots_source: A1 code-true simple/20 @ s12 (a3 BOM B-canary row)
config.adapters: NONE — base stack; no turbo, no LoRA, no VDN (ledger B: attachment policy n/a)
config.kernel: stock attention routing; SageAttention ABSENT from the venv (import fails) — off by absence

cache_bust.mechanism: ComfyUI 0.37.4 InputSignature outputs cache returns cached nodes for identical input values (found on pass 1: r2-r4 executed 0.84 s, zero model lines — cached decode re-saved). No per-prompt nocache exists; busted via provably render-neutral value changes:
levers: vae_v name alternation over three byte-identical files (sha256 7c1f131492e7…): minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors / musubi_video_vae_fp16.safetensors / minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16__setBalias.safetensors (symlink) — feeds MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo, so the whole pipeline (TE encode, canvas, sampling, decodes) re-executes on identical weights

RandomNoise.control_after_generate cycled fixed/increment/decrement — frontend-only widget key (execute() takes noise_seed only, nodes_custom_sampler.py:1014); zero server-side effect, changes the cache signature
cache_bust.identity_proof: all three vae files sha256-identical (MANIFEST.md line 49 + computed); symlink resolves to the same inode; seed/prompt/steps/sampler/sigma array byte-identical across all runs
